title: Server
footer: Silo v1 is deprecated and will stop working once the server drops the /api/v1 API. Use Auto or v2 when your server supports it.

title: Authentication

items.title: Use API Key
items.subtitle: Sign in with an API key instead of a username and password.

footer: Sign in with your Silo username and password, or turn on Use API Key and paste an unscoped API key (sa_...) for long-lived access. API keys skip profile PIN prompts.

title: Profile

items.title: Profile
items.placeholder: Profile name or ID (defaults to primary)

items.title: Profile PIN
items.placeholder: PIN (only if the profile is locked)

footer: Silo requires a profile for reading and progress sync. Leave the profile blank to use the account's primary profile.

title: Reading

items.title: Use Comic Pages plugin
items.subtitle: Extract CBR pages on the server when the plugin is installed.

items.title: Mark chapters read on Silo
items.subtitle: Marks a chapter as read on Silo when you open or download it in Aidoku.

footer: With the Comic Pages plugin installed on Silo, CBR pages are extracted on the server; the source finds it automatically on v2 servers. Enter an installation ID only for v1 servers. Without the plugin, CBR chapters are decoded on the device.
